title: Microsoft Viva: identifiable export of Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing prerequisite and administrator-controlled identification are supported by Microsoft's documentation. Both control paths omit the initial Settings heading; the governance checklist also names access inventory and audit-history checks that have no corresponding control rows.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft plans identifiable row-level Copilot Dashboard exports for reporting and deeper analysis.
claims.quote: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

claims.claim: The roadmap says administrators can turn the capability on in a tenant.
claims.quote: This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development"

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Ordinary Copilot exports replace personal identifiers with anonymised IDs.
claims.quote: Personal identifiers are removed and replaced with anonymized IDs, unless your administrator has enabled identifiable export for you.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Exports include identifiable fields when an administrator enables identifiable export for the user.
claims.quote: If your administrator has enabled identifiable export, the export also includes identifiable fields.

claims.claim: Eligible users select Export data and Export by week in the Copilot Dashboard for weekly exports.
claims.quote: Eligible tenants and users can export directly from the Copilot Dashboard by selecting Export data. ... Select Export by week, to download the last six months of data

claims.claim: Weekly exports contain six months of week-level data.
claims.quote: Each week-level export contains six months of week-level aggregated Copilot metrics at the user level (with identifiers removed) across the adoption and impact pages.

claims.claim: Eligible users select Export data and Export by day for daily exports.
claims.quote: Eligible tenants and users can export directly from the Copilot Dashboard by selecting Export data. ... or select Export by day, to download the last 28 days of data.

claims.claim: Daily exports contain 28 days of day-level data.
claims.quote: You can download week-level metrics spanning the past six months, or day-level metrics spanning the past 28 days.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Export access requires global access to the Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Access requirement – You must have global access to the Copilot Dashboard.

claims.claim: Automatically identified senior leaders are among eligible exporters.
claims.quote: Senior leaders automatically identified through Entra ID data.

claims.claim: Users manually assigned global access by administrators are among eligible exporters.
claims.quote: Users manually assigned global access by admins

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Delegates assigned by users with global access are among eligible exporters.
claims.quote: Delegates assigned by users with global access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Viva Insights Analysts with global access are among eligible exporters.
claims.quote: Viva Insights Analysts with global access

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators are among eligible exporters.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators

claims.claim: Users with non-global access, such as managers with team-level views, cannot export.
claims.quote: Users with non-global access, such as managers with team-level views, can't access this feature to export data.

claims.claim: Delegates of users with global access inherit export access unless an administrator policy disables it.
claims.quote: Yes. Delegates of users with global access automatically inherit data export access, unless your organization's admin policy disables it.

claims.claim: Users cannot customise the exports.
claims.quote: You can't customize the exports.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The export page describes a public-preview feature.
claims.quote: This feature is for public preview customers only. Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.claim: The identification overview lists Copilot Dashboard data export as Private Preview.
claims.quote: Copilot Dashboard data export (Private Preview)

claims.claim: Microsoft calls identification sensitive because identified outputs reveal named users.
claims.quote: Because identified outputs reveal named users, identification is a sensitive capability.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Identification access is governed by a dedicated Viva Feature Access Management policy.
claims.quote: Access is governed by a dedicated Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) policy, so administrators decide exactly who in the organization can identify users and view identified outputs.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Only a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or AI Administrator can create and manage identification access policies.
claims.quote: Only a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or an AI Administrator can create and manage identification access policies. Either role can perform every step, in both the Microsoft 365 admin center and PowerShell.

claims.claim: Identification policies can target groups, individual users or the whole tenant.
claims.quote: VFAM lets you enable or disable specific Microsoft 365 and Viva features for chosen groups, users, or your whole tenant

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Identifiable export is administrator opt-in: identifiers remain removed unless an administrator has enabled it.
claims.quote: Personal identifiers are removed and replaced with anonymized IDs, unless your administrator has enabled identifiable export for you.

claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly print a default value for the Copilot Dashboard identifiable-export setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Dashboard" "identifiable" "FeatureId" default; read export-copilot-metrics and identification-copilot-analytics. Neither explicitly labels this identification setting's default; the export page conditions identification on admin enablement.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The export prerequisite is at least 50 assigned Copilot or Viva Insights licences in the tenant.
claims.quote: License requirement – Your tenant must have at least 50 Copilot or Viva Insights licenses assigned.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included within the qualifying Copilot or Viva Insights licensing.
claims.quote: License requirement – Your tenant must have at least 50 Copilot or Viva Insights licenses assigned.

claims.claim: Individual dashboard viewers do not need a paid Viva Insights or Microsoft Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Users don't need a paid Viva Insights license or a Microsoft Copilot license.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a licence specific to identifiable Copilot Dashboard export.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Dashboard" "identifiable" "price" "license"; Copilot Dashboard identifiable export licensing price meter feature ID default. Read export prerequisites, dashboard licence availability and identification overview; no identification-specific licence.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: No separate identifiable-export price or charge is published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Dashboard" "identifiable" "price" "license"; Copilot Dashboard identifiable export licensing price meter feature ID default. Read export, dashboard licensing and identification pages; none publishes a separate identifiable-export price or charge.

claims.claim: The export page lists no identifiable-export meter.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Dashboard identifiable export licensing price meter feature ID default; searched the fetched export-copilot-metrics text for meter, price and charge. Read its prerequisites and the dashboard licensing table; no identifiable-export meter stated.

claims.claim: VFAM policy creation requires a supported version of Microsoft 365 or a Viva Suite licence.
claims.quote: Policy creation requires the following elements: A supported version of Microsoft 365 or a Viva Suite license.

claims.claim: VFAM access controls are unavailable in GCC High.
claims.quote: The access controls described in this document aren't available in GCC-High or DoD.

claims.claim: VFAM access controls are unavailable in DoD.
claims.quote: The access controls described in this document aren't available in GCC-High or DoD.

claims.claim: Data processing can take up to seven days after licence assignment, with more recent processing for day-level exports.
claims.quote: Data processing in Copilot Analytics takes up to seven days following license assignment, unless you're exporting day-level metrics, which provides more recent data.

claims.claim: Access-policy changes can take up to 24 hours to take effect.
claims.quote: Changes to access policies take effect for the user within 24 hours, unless noted for a specific feature.

claims.claim: Scripting VFAM policies requires Exchange Online PowerShell 3.2.0 or later.
claims.quote: Access to Exchange Online PowerShell Version 3.2.0 or later.

claims.claim: Non-mail-enabled groups require Exchange PowerShell 3.5.1 or later.
claims.quote: If you need to use non-mail-enabled groups you must have access to Exchange PowerShell version 3.5.1 or later.

claims.claim: VFAM policy creation, updates and deletions can be reviewed in the organisation's Microsoft Purview change logs.
claims.quote: For a history of policy creation, updates, and deletions, see the Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) change logs for your organization in Microsoft Purview.

claims.claim: One VFAM export control covers both week-level and day-level export.
claims.quote: The VFAM control is a single unified control for both the week-level and day-level export options.

claims.where: controls[1]; Scope; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Global admins can disable user-level export for leaders and managers using the export policy.
claims.quote: Global admins can disable or re-enable the feature for the tenant or specific groups through Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) ... When off, leaders and managers can't export user-level data

claims.claim: The User-level export and insights setting also governs leaders' and managers' user-level insights.
claims.quote: When off, leaders and managers can't export user-level data or view user-level insights on specific cards, and Interactive insights provides aggregated insights only.

claims.claim: The User-level export and insights setting is always on for analysts and cannot be changed for that role.
claims.quote: Since analysts already have access to user-level data through advanced analysis experiences, the above-mentioned setting is always on for the analyst role and can't be changed.

claims.claim: Learn does not print the identification feature ID specifically for Copilot Dashboard export.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Dashboard" "identifiable" "FeatureId" default; read identification-copilot-analytics, export-copilot-metrics, feature-access-management and manage-access-policies. No Copilot Dashboard identification feature ID printed; Agent page names its own.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard export page names IdentifiableExport as its identification setting.
claims.quote: Identifiability on/off: Identifiable export is controlled with the "IdentifiableExport" VFAM setting and is off by default.

claims.claim: Agent Dashboard exports honour applicable administrator exclusion policies.
claims.quote: Exports honor applicable admin exclusion policies. Agents or users excluded from reporting do not appear in the corresponding export output.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights returns supported Viva Insights features and their feature IDs.
claims.quote: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights ... Find the feature that you'd like to create an access policy for and make note of its featureID.

claims.claim: Each feature supports up to 10 policies assigned to users and groups.
claims.quote: You can assign a maximum of 10 policies per feature to users and groups.

claims.claim: Each policy can target at most 20 users or groups.
claims.quote: Each policy can be assigned to a maximum of 20 users or groups.

claims.claim: One additional tenant-wide policy is allowed per feature.
claims.quote: You can assign one additional policy per feature to the entire tenant by using the -Everyone parameter

claims.claim: The identification page supplies a different administrator route from the Manage feature access page.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Org settings > Viva feature access, select Viva Insights, choose the identification feature, and add a policy.

claims.claim: The identification policy can be enabled through Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app and feature > Access setting > On.
claims.quote: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu. Select the Settings tab and select Manage feature access. Select Create a policy.
claims.fix: Include the initial Settings heading: 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app and feature > Access setting > On'. The cited page gives the remaining selections as 'select the app and feature' and 'Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off'.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId <featureId> -Name <policyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $true -Everyone enables the identified feature for the tenant.
claims.quote: use the Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy PowerShell cmdlet to create an access policy for the feature. ... You can assign one additional policy per feature to the entire tenant by using the -Everyone parameter

claims.claim: The export policy can be disabled through Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app and feature > Access setting > Off.
claims.quote: From the Microsoft 365 admin center, select Viva from the settings menu. ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off to enable or disable the feature.
claims.fix: Include the initial Settings heading: 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app and feature > Access setting > Off', following https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId <featureId> -Name <policyName> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables the identified feature for the tenant.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name UsersAndGroups -IsFeatureEnabled $false ... If you want to disable the feature for all users, use the -Everyone parameter instead.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Data exposure
claims.claim: The described export is a user-requested download, not an autonomous action.
claims.quote: After you select Export data, the download starts automatically in your browser.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and After rollout
claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to inventory global dashboard access and inspect Purview policy history, but the table has only identification and export-policy rows.
claims.quote: List who holds global access to the Copilot Dashboard, including delegates ... Review VFAM policy history in the Microsoft Purview change logs ... Table: Which users can export identifiable ... Whether leaders and managers can export user-level ...
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullets beginning 'List who holds global access to the Copilot Dashboard' and 'Review VFAM policy history in the Microsoft Purview change logs' so the checklist names only controls represented in the existing table.
